function.name: list_surfaces
function.description: List shared Surface instances, their IDs, names, types, and joined people. Artifact, bot, and task Surfaces include their target's live name and ID while it is available, or an unavailable state without them. Document Surfaces include promptDocument: null, or the description admins gave it as one of the installation's important documents. Each todo, document, calendar, or System Monitor tool requires a Surface ID. Results are paged.
